title: START production, first supervised run: Arcadia's 7-bug Plan (Codex only, one Action at a time, draft PRs only, never merges; approves its own build packets for 24h)
problem: ONE PRESS TURNS PRODUCTION ON FOR ARCADIA'S OWN REPOSITORY. For each of the 7 Actions of the Plan seven-verified-settlement-queue-and-preservation-integrity-bugs-are-fixed-and (keep-claim-when-passed-attempt-receipt-is-unparseable, settle-superseded-decision-ask-rejection, amend-action-consumes-block-scalar-and-literal-ids, keep-queue-positions-of-projects-not-visible-at-arrange, refuse-hidden-renames-in-committed-completion-replay, allocate-decision-numbers-from-origin-and-refuse-duplicates, write-yaml-scalars-that-round-trip-as-strings), the production worker may approve the build packet it prepared (delegation, Decision 0072, expiring 24 hours after the press), launch one Codex Session, and preserve its work to a pushed branch and a DRAFT pull request. At most one Session at a time. It never readies, reviews or merges a pull request and never pushes a base branch: a supervising agent reviews and merges each PR before the next Action launches, and a PR that touches authority waits for you. The policy itself has no expiry: it ends when the 7 Actions finish or when you press the STOP button (restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11). The capacity gate is whatever the workspace config says; this button does not change it, and the receipt records whether Codex was metered. Per Decision 0123 you approved the Codex-only, attended first run and then chose the packet-approval delegation and no policy expiry. An Action already approved is still admitted after the delegation expires (#1012). If you do not want this, do not press.
desired_effect: After fail-closed preconditions (launched from the actions library; main clean, level with origin and with a fresh ls-remote; Decision 0123 approved with an answer; the Plan active; the installed release ready and runtime-identical to main; the capacity read admitting codex-cli; production Inactive with zero live admissions and this request id unused), compute the delegation expiry as 24 hours from now, preview at the current policy revision, preview again immediately before activation requiring the identical fingerprint and revision, activate once with that expected revision and request id grant-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11 and Decision 0123, then verify the activated fingerprint equals the preview and turn this Grant Off on any mismatch: Project arcadia, Plan arcadia/seven-verified-settlement-queue-and-preservation-integrity-bugs-are-fixed-and, exactly its 7 Actions, provider codex-cli, concurrency one, transitions validation, acceptance, pointer and packet_approval with a 24-hour packet-approval expiry, --remote-preservation, no integration grant, no rehearsal exception.

does: Runs only when launched from the operator-action library (exact id and descriptor) outside any agent sandbox, with its script and descriptor tracked and unmodified at the main checkout's HEAD

Requires main clean, level with last-fetched origin/main and with a fresh 30-second ls-remote, Decision 0123 approved with a recorded answer, the Plan active, an installed broker release that is ready and runtime-identical to main, and the capacity read admitting codex-cli (a refused provider would stall the first tick, so it refuses before changing anything)
Requires production Inactive with zero live admissions and this request id not already in the policy

Previews at the current policy revision, previews again immediately before activation and requires the identical fingerprint and revision, activates once with --expected-revision and its own request id, then verifies the activated fingerprint; the preview must name exactly the 7 Plan Actions (compared as a set), codex-cli, concurrency one, remote preservation, the delegated mechanics and the 24-hour packet-approval expiry, and no integration grant

Under Decision 0072 lets the worker approve the build packet of an Action inside this exact scope, only for codex-cli, only while the policy is Active and the delegation unexpired; under remote preservation the worker pushes the preserved candidate branch and opens its draft pull request

After any activation attempt that does not verify (including a failed, timed-out or unparsable activate, or SIGTERM/SIGINT), reads production status back, returns only its own Grant to Off if it is Active, and records the observed state (or UNKNOWN, telling you to press STOP now) in a timestamped receipt and failure handoff
never_does: Never authorizes a GitHub merge, readying a pull request, a reviewer run or a push to any base branch: there is no integration grant, so the worker only pushes branches and opens draft pull requests
Never grants another Project, Plan, Action (anything beyond the 7 named), provider, transition or a concurrency above one, and never lifts the concurrency gate
Never edits the workspace config or changes the capacity gate, credentials, branch protection, repository settings or any Decision, Plan or Action
Never launches, terminates or resumes a Session, restarts a service, or reactivates production after Off
Never activates twice under its request id: the one-shot button stays disabled after success
Never turns a failed or unverified activation into a success: it returns only its own Grant to Off and says so

success.effect: One scoped policy is Active under request id grant-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11 whose recorded fingerprint equals both previews; the receipt names the 7 Actions, the packet-approval expiry, the capacity gate state, the installed release and main.
success.next: Watch production status and the dashboard: the tick prepares and approves the first packet and launches a Codex Session. A supervising agent reviews and merges each draft PR before the next Action launches. To stop at any time press restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11.

failure.effect: If no activation was attempted, policy is unchanged. After an attempt, the script reads production status back, returns only its own Grant to Off when it is Active, and records the observed result (not_active, returned_off, other_grant_active, OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN).
failure.next: Do not press again blindly. Read the handoff; if it says OFF_FAILED or UNKNOWN, press restore-off-production-bug-plan-first-supervised-run-2026-10-11 now. Otherwise resolve the named drift and ask for a fresh Grant.
